set -eu; EXPECTED_MAIN=0aadac51003540a8b56fa72eca4984c9a8271b20; EXPECTED_BRANCH=202362ad2dba129d809db02a87913377d3e94064; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; PKG=pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge; export ANDROID_HOME="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk"; export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="$ANDROID_HOME"; GRADLE_BIN="$HOME/.gradle/local-agent/gradle-9.6.0/bin/gradle"; git fetch origin main agent/gate-a-ready-to-dial; test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$EXPECTED_MAIN"; git checkout -B agent/gate-a-ready-to-dial origin/agent/gate-a-ready-to-dial; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED_BRANCH"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; CALL_STATE=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1); test "$CALL_STATE" = 0; echo gate_a_call_state_before=$CALL_STATE; "$GRADLE_BIN" :app:assembleDebug >/tmp/gate-a-s22-build.log 2>&1 || { cat /tmp/gate-a-s22-build.log; exit 1; }; adb -s "$SERIAL" install -r app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk >/tmp/gate-a-s22-install.log 2>&1 || { cat /tmp/gate-a-s22-install.log; exit 1; }; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell run-as "$PKG" rm -f files/local-phone-llm-speech-pipeline-report.txt 2>/dev/null || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am force-stop "$PKG"; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell am start -W -n "$PKG/.DiagnosticProbeActivity" --ez run_local_phone_llm_speech_pipeline_probe true >/tmp/gate-a-s22-start.log; REPORT=''; for _ in $(seq 1 360); do REPORT=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell run-as "$PKG" cat files/local-phone-llm-speech-pipeline-report.txt 2>/dev/null | tr -d '' || true); printf '%s
' "$REPORT" | grep -q '^probe_complete=true$' && break; sleep 0.5; done; echo '--- gate A S22 report ---'; printf '%s
' "$REPORT"; echo '--- end gate A S22 report ---'; printf '%s
' "$REPORT" | grep -q '^call_required=false$'; printf '%s
' "$REPORT" | grep -q '^openai_api_used=false$'; printf '%s
' "$REPORT" | grep -q '^readiness_state=READY_TO_DIAL$'; printf '%s
' "$REPORT" | grep -q '^ready_to_dial=true$'; printf '%s
' "$REPORT" | grep -q '^model_warmup_complete=true$'; printf '%s
' "$REPORT" | grep -q '^stt_transcript_nonblank=true$'; printf '%s
' "$REPORT" | grep -q '^backend_complete_response=true$'; printf '%s
' "$REPORT" | grep -q '^approved_output_pcm_nonempty=true$'; printf '%s
' "$REPORT" | grep -q '^local_phone_llm_speech_pipeline_success=true$'; CALL_STATE_AFTER=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1); test "$CALL_STATE_AFTER" = 0; echo gate_a_call_state_after=$CALL_STATE_AFTER; HELPER=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell pidof "$PKG:call_media" 2>/dev/null | tr -d '' || true); test -z "$HELPER"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; echo gate_a_ready_to_dial_proven_s22=true
